posts.title: The UK Post Office planned an issue of stamps in 1969 to commemorate the first flight of Concorde….
posts.description: ALT The UK Post Office planned an issue of stamps in 1969 to commemorate the first flight of Concorde . This is a design submitted by Margaret Calvert in 1967, which was rejected; the page does not record the reason why. Collect GB Stamp’s page links to a PDF with ten rejected designs , including another by Calvert. ALT

posts.title: Renderings of adsb.lol data over or near the United States for the 24 hours from 3am Eastern (0800Z)…
posts.description: Renderings of adsb.lol data over or near the United States for the 24 hours from 3am Eastern (0800Z) on the 12th (top) and 13th (bottom) of November until the following 3am. The times the FAA ground stop was in effect on the 13th are marked with a red clock. Visuals inspired by Aaron Koblin’s classic Flight Patterns . Data from adsb.lol (Open Database Licence). posts.description: I’ve continued to work on t100.husk.org , my site that takes US flight data and recombines it in ways that are (hopefully) able to give insights into the patterns of general aviation over the last thirty plus years.
